name: ClancyClaw
short_desc: ClancyClaw with split Ollama chat + embeddings
author: OpenClaw
description: Run ClancyClaw against your external Ollama stack with chat models on 192.168.1.162:11435 and embeddings on 192.168.1.162:11437.

form_fields.label: ClancyClaw Gateway Token
form_fields.hint: Required token for Control UI and WebSocket auth.

form_fields.label: Ollama Chat Base URLs
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated native Ollama endpoints for chat and generate traffic.

form_fields.label: Ollama Embedding Base URL
form_fields.hint: Native Ollama endpoint used for embedding and rerank traffic.

form_fields.label: Ollama API Key
form_fields.hint: Any non-empty value works for local Ollama.

form_fields.label: Ollama Embedding Model
form_fields.hint: Embedding model used by memory search with Ollama.

form_fields.label: Trusted Proxy CIDRs
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated proxy IPs or CIDRs allowed to forward client IP headers.

form_fields.label: Fallback Model Ref
form_fields.hint: Optional fallback model ref. Leave blank to disable fallback.
